paper_identity_blockers: The released PickScore LoRA uses chatgpt_custom_animal prompts and rank 16; the released HPS+Aesthetic LoRA uses chatgpt_custom_instruments prompts and rank 8. Neither release is identified as a Table 1 checkpoint.
Table 1 does not fix the base model/configuration for every column, seeds, samples per prompt, checkpoint-selection rule, or aggregation implementation.
The action/evaluation prompt files needed to reproduce Table 1 were deleted before the public release tag; remaining prompt ingredients do not establish the original train/test split.
The README's 450-step, four-A6000 example is not identified with a paper metric row or either released LoRA.
required_before_reopen: Identify a paper-matching Table 1 base checkpoint and final VADER checkpoint, with hashes and release provenance.
Recover or author-supply the exact Table 1 prompt/data manifests, train/test split, seeds, samples per prompt, checkpoint-selection rule and aggregation code.
Freeze evaluator revisions, reward weights, media decoding and metric aggregation for every Table 1 column.
Establish that the requested training configuration and endpoint correspond to a paper claim, not only the 450-step example.

After all identity/protocol gates pass, preregister one-batch decode, differentiable generation/reward, backward, optimizer, checkpoint and resume tests, then set a claimed metric and stopping rule before full training.
